Name: Broken Buildings
Author: Yelanir
Description:
[b]Overview:[/b]
Add immersion and bring your farm’s past back to life with Grandpa’s old, worn-down buildings.
Instead of relying on paths to reserve space while planning your layout, you can place these ruined buildings instantly and for free, then restore them over time.
It also adds a bit of narrative consistency. If the farm once belonged to your grandpa, why are the farmhouse and greenhouse the only buildings left? (Seriously, didn't he have any other buildings?)


[b]Features & Details:[/b]
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17466]glymr's Broken Farmhouse[/url], this mod adds broken, pre-upgrade versions of all vanilla buildings. These can be placed instantly at no cost and later upgraded into their standard functional versions, making them ideal for planning your farm layout in a natural, immersive way.
All vanilla buildings are included, along with the Wizard’s buildings, which can be toggled on and off and you can configure whether they appear in Robin’s or the Wizard’s menu.
Buildings have broken roofs and overgrown vines. It uses darker tones and desaturated textures to reflect wear over time, and helping them blend with both vanilla assets and recolour mods. An optional seasonal variant is also available (enabled by default), helping them blend better with the environment.
These are not separate alternatives, but earlier states of the vanilla buildings. Meaning the standard versions now act as upgrades. This allows you to place buildings in advance without cheating, since the original costs, materials, and progression of the vanilla buildings remain unchanged.


[b]Config Settings:
[/b]You can:
[list]
[*]Enable or disable seasonal changes (enabled by default)
[*]Enable or disable the Wizard's Buildings (enabled by default)
[*]Choose who builds the broken Wizard's buildings: Robin or Wizard (Robin by default)
[/list]

[b]Compatibility:

[/b][list]
[*]Compatible with mods that change building costs or materials
[/list]
[list]
[*]Partially compatible with building retexture mods (﻿doesn't replace vanilla buildings; it only adds a prior upgrade stage, so only this stage looks vanilla).
[/list]
[list]
[*]Works well with vanilla and recolor mods thanks to its desaturated palette, which fits thematically.
[/list]

[b]Permissions:[/b]
You are free to make any recolour or translations without asking for permission, just don't use AI.
If you make a recolour, please give credit and link back to this mod.
If you make a translation, you may public it yourself only posting the i18n translated file. And if you'd like it to be included directly in the main mod, feel free to send it to me and I'll add it.
